who.value: Buyer with items from several sellers in their cart

job.value: Review cart items grouped by seller and check out with one seller

arrivedFrom.value: The cart icon or an 'Add to cart' on a listing

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The 'Cart' heading over per-seller cards (calliepoo_, refashsg) with items and prices makes the purpose immediate.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: Each seller card ends in a full-width teal 'Checkout' button beside '1 item · S$22.00', the strongest element in each card.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Checkout' is clear, but the item delete is an unlabelled trash icon and 'All promos' carries a gear icon that reads as settings.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Buyer Protection', 'Like new' and 'Waived platform fee' are everyday terms for a Carousell buyer.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The only choice is which seller to check out with, which the buyer already knows.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Promo detail is behind 'All promos' and only the applied 'Waived platform fee' line shows inline.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything on screen (items, condition, per-seller totals, Checkout) belongs to reviewing a cart.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Thumbnails, prices and the 'Checkout' button carry it; there is no explanatory copy to read.
